Pick a discipline

01 / PLAN

Strategy & planning

Marketing strategy, audience research, campaign planning, media planning and budget allocation across channels and markets.

02 / RUN

Campaign management

Campaign setup, audience targeting, creative testing, bidding strategies and cross-platform management on Meta, Google, TikTok and Snapchat.

03 / SCALE

Optimization & growth

Performance optimization, budget scaling, conversion-rate optimization, customer acquisition and profitability improvement.

04 / PROVE

Tracking & reporting

Conversion tracking, analytics implementation, KPI monitoring, performance dashboards and monthly reporting you can read in five minutes.

05 / KEEP

Retention & lifecycle

Klaviyo email and SMS flows: welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase, win-back, plus segmentation and campaign calendars.

06 / SEASON

Sale-event campaigns

Black Friday, Ramadan, White Friday and seasonal pushes: discount rules, bundles, landing pages and ad creative planned together.

Business analysis for Odoo

Business analysis for Odoo ERP implementations: we gather the requirements, map the workflows, find the gaps and turn business needs into effective ERP solutions, so operations and Odoo functionality line up.

REQUIREMENTS

Business requirements gathering

Workshops and interviews with each department to capture what the business actually needs before configuration starts.

WORKFLOWS

Workflow analysis

Current-state process mapping to see where work slows down, repeats or breaks, and what the target flow should look like.

GAPS

Gap identification

Fit-gap review of requirements against standard Odoo, so you know what is covered, what needs setup and what needs customization.

SOLUTIONS

Needs into ERP solutions

Translating business needs into Odoo configuration, custom modules and dashboards, aligned with how your operations really run.

We have run stores from the inside for six years. That is what we bring to yours: development plus the daily operations that keep it growing.

BUILD

Store build & migration

New stores and redesigns on Shopify, WooCommerce, Salla and Zid; migrations from Magento, WordPress or custom platforms.

DEV

Development & integrations

Custom Liquid builds, theme and speed optimization, app audits, local payment gateways (Paymob, Valu, Tabby, Tamara) and shipping apps.

ERP

Shopify / WooCommerce ↔ Odoo sync

Real-time inventory and order sync, webhook and API error handling, so stock online matches stock in the warehouse.

LISTINGS

A+ CONTENT

A+ & enhanced content

Feature blocks, comparison charts, lifestyle modules and infographics that explain the product and lift conversion.

TRANSLATION

Arabic ↔ English translation

Translation and localization of titles, descriptions, A+ modules and store pages, with consistent terminology across markets.

SEO · CRO

SEO & conversion

Keyword research, on-page and technical SEO; PDP, collection and checkout UX fixes that raise conversion and AOV.

MARKETPLACE

Marketplace management

Amazon, Noon, Jumia and Raneen vendor dashboards: listings, A+ content, pricing and order accuracy.

CARE

How we work

Audit. Plan. Build. Grow.

Every engagement starts with numbers, not a pitch deck. We look at your store, your ads and your back-office, then agree on what moves the P&L first.

01

Audit

Store speed, funnel, ad accounts, catalog and ERP gaps. You get a written list of fixes ranked by revenue impact.

02

Plan

A 90-day plan with budgets, creative needs, dev tickets and the KPIs we will report on.

03

Build

Storefront, creatives, campaigns and Odoo configured in parallel by one team that sits in the same room.

04

Grow

Weekly optimization, monthly reporting, quarterly re-planning. Scale what works, cut what doesn't.

Audit5 days
90-day plan2 weeks
Store / Odoo build4–8 weeks
Ads & creativeLive in week 1
